'''Jet juice''' was a colloquial term for a particular [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]-distilled liquid [[Alcohol/Legends|intoxicant]] distilled by [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] on lengthy trips. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] kept a flask of this alcohol under the control console of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

Jet juice was also sold in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="RE">{{JournalCite|7|Rebel Escape}}</ref>
